summary: The first Steering Group meeting for the AITY project focused on reviewing and approving the initial Project Plan. Discussions covered the Figma prototype, file formats, and risk management. Key decisions include finalizing design documentation before coding begins and expanding the test plan. The plan was approved subject to revisions before the next meeting in March.
keywords: AITY, AI Agent, Project Plan, Text Analysis, Prototype
topics: Project Management, Software Development, Quality Assurance
